captions: 6:02 p.m. One last email: “Tower B — handover approved.”
Two years. Every beam, every delay, every late night.
Your name on the plaque. It will stand for a hundred years.
Driving home in the rain. The tower lights up behind you.
Then your phone, on the dashboard: the adhan for Maghrib.
A hundred years of concrete. You won't be here for most of them.
You stop at the mosque. Your helmet stays in the car.
Three rak'ahs with the row. Then two more, just for Him.
No plaque. No handover. But this one, you take with you.

post.caption:
14 floors in 2 years. What have you built for Allah? 🌙

6:02 p.m. “Tower B — handover approved.” Your name on the plaque, for a hundred years. Then, driving home in the rain, the adhan for Maghrib — and you realise you won't be here for most of those years.

“Every soul will taste death.” (3:185)

Tonight at Isha: two extra rak'ahs. Build what stays.
